The limb requires the trip to be terminated 'at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed', and limb (c) fixes the start of that dwell at the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not at the arrived tap. The first qualifying in-geofence fix on the trace is 23:42:21 and the trip was cancelled at 23:49:05, 404 seconds later - the driver pulled the plug 76 seconds before the 480th second. discarded_claims.claim: Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is not made out either. It requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence 'at or before' the arrived event, and the earliest qualifying in-geofence fix on the trace is 23:42:21, which post-dates the trip record's 23:42:10 marker; the trace jumps from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21, so the 186-second gap swallows the moment of entry and no fix sits at the marker at all. The only route to limb (b) is to repair the timestamps using the 228-second device clock skew, and POL-NS-08(a) treats a skew over 90 seconds as an unsafe match between the arrived event and a GPS fix. ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the $6.00 charge is a driver-cancelled no-show fee at Changi T1 Arrival Door 6 (AIRPORT zone class, RYDE_X vehicle). The fare line itself is in order — $6.00 is the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee ($6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00), and it reconciles with EV-FARE-00210 (weight 1.0, no issues), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. The dispute turns entirely on whether the driver actually held position inside the pickup geofence for the AIRPORT minimum of 480 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (POL-NS-01 limb (c)).

The only evidence that can carry that fact is the GPS trace, EV-GPS-00210. It is impaired at weight 0.25 on CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD: the device clock runs 228 s ahead of the server (over the 90 s limb in POL-NS-08(a)), a 186 s gap sits exactly across the moment of geofence entry, coverage is 22.8%, and the trace stops 149 s before the cancellation. Read at face value the first qualifying fix is 23:42:21 and the dwell to the 23:49:05 cancellation is 404 s — 76 s short; corrected for the 228 s skew the same fix maps to 23:38:33 and the dwell is 632 s, comfortably over. The gap conceals the one fact that would choose between them, so this finding does not survive the discount.

The trip record, EV-TRIP-00210 (weight 0.4, IMPAIRED, CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT), does not settle it either: its arrived 23:42:10 with a 6.9-minute (414 s) wait cannot be reconciled with the trace. The chat log, EV-CHAT-00210 (weight 0.6, IMPAIRED, TRUNCATED_LOG), carries 2 of the 4 messages for the window and says nothing about dwell. No traffic advisory covers the pickup road (EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0), so POL-NS-06 limb (i) adds nothing and no time can be summed.

Because the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) and (b); because two admissible artifacts, EV-TRIP-00210 and EV-GPS-00210, contradict each other directly on arrival and on dwell and no clause resolves the conflict; and because the deciding fact is carried only by artifacts of weight 0.25 and 0.40 — a confidence ceiling of 0.40, below the platform-wide floor of 0.70 — the case is escalated under POL-NS-09 limbs (a), (b) and (e). Escalation is terminal: I issue no monetary ruling, and the $6.00 is held on its present PENDING status rather than collected or refunded, so that neither party funds a dispute the platform has not resolved.

Open question for the reviewer: reconstruct the 23:39:15–23:42:21 entry and reconcile the 228 s device skew against the server timestamps well enough to fix the in-geofence dwell against the 480 s AIRPORT minimum. If the corrected dwell meets 480 s, the fee stands and POL-NS-07 compensation falls due (the anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d 2 is below 4, and 2/156 = 0.013 is below 0.08). If it does not, POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full.
